weeks.title: Week 1: Defined Benefit Pension Basics
weeks.lessonHtml:
Week 1: Defined Benefit Pension Basics

Learning Objectives

  • Calculate projected benefit obligation (PBO)
  • Measure plan assets at fair value
  • Compute service cost, interest cost, and expected return on assets
  • Determine funded status (PBO vs. plan assets)

Key Topics

1. PBO measurement

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to PBO measurement. Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply PBO measurement concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: PBO measurement is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

2. Plan assets

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to Plan assets. Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply Plan assets concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: Plan assets is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

3. Service cost and interest cost

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to Service cost and interest cost. Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply Service cost and interest cost concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: Service cost and interest cost is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

4. Funded status

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to Funded status. Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply Funded status concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: Funded status is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

Practice Application

Work through practice problems applying week 1: defined benefit pension basics concepts. These problems mirror actual CPA exam scenarios and real-world CFO challenges.

Key Takeaways

  • Master PBO measurement for exam success and professional competence
  • Master Plan assets for exam success and professional competence
  • Master Service cost and interest cost for exam success and professional competence
  • Master Funded status for exam success and professional competence
  • Understand authoritative guidance and when to apply it
  • Practice computational problems until you can solve them efficiently
  • Connect concepts to real-world CFO responsibilities

weeks.title: Week 2: Pension Expense & OCI
weeks.lessonHtml:
Week 2: Pension Expense & OCI

Learning Objectives

  • Amortize prior service cost from OCI

weeks.title: Week 3: Share-Based Compensation (ASC 718)
weeks.lessonHtml:
Week 3: Share-Based Compensation (ASC 718)

Learning Objectives

  • Measure stock option fair value (Black-Scholes or binomial)
  • Account for RSUs (restricted stock units)

weeks.title: Week 4: Modifications, Tax Effects, and Disclosures
weeks.lessonHtml:
Week 4: Modifications, Tax Effects, and Disclosures

Learning Objectives

  • Account for award modifications (incremental cost)
  • Apply tax effects of stock compensation (APIC pool)
  • Calculate diluted EPS with stock options (treasury stock method)
